title: Pays for counter disappears when the count drops to 0
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B in Edit Customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's page.
  2. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  3. In "Bill Invoices To", pick "[customer A's name] (this customer)".
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open customer B's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Pays for" counter shows 1.

Step 2:

  • "Bill Invoices To" shows customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The field shows "[customer A's name] (this customer)".

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • Customer B's page shows Contacts and Assets.
  • No "Pays for" counter shows.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-N4: “The "Pays for" counter is hidden when the count is 0.”
  • S1-R5: “The field's first option is "[customer] (this customer)"; picking it and saving clears the default.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
